attributes.name: Blessing of Angradd
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to any check that has the Fire trait.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to any check against a barrier encountered by a character at your location.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings has the Basic trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
